notes: Both release tags resolve directly to commits rather than annotated tag objects.
Both pinned commits have a good cryptographic signature from GitHub's published web-flow key; local owner trust remains unknown and is not overstated.
Upstream source checkouts and generated build outputs are intentionally excluded from the application repository.
Go 1.27.0 is not the go.mod-declared toolchain and failed the Windows runtime compatibility gate. No BLS-initializer bypass was applied.
The exact go.mod-declared Go 1.26.5 Linux toolchain passed the focused Prysm compatibility gate.
The ML-DSA-65 verifier is a Sepehr-specific experimental precompile, not an Ethereum standard; its fixed gas schedule requires independent multi-platform benchmarking before a public network.
The experimental Prysm recovery patch admits equal-head peers after a simultaneous private-network restart and preserves current-epoch duties if next-epoch lookahead temporarily fails at a boundary.

Each clean run generates a fresh genesis time, so run-specific genesis.ssz hashes are evidence rather than one falsely fixed hash; all runs use the same committed consensus parameters and the same four disjoint 64-validator ranges. Generated validator keys are excluded from Git.
